# Frozen-bytes corpus — the v1-beta wire / byte / golden / codepoint / KAT /
# invariant pins.
#
# Consumed by `.github/workflows/frozen-bytes.yml`. One cargo test-target name
# per line (the file stem of a `crates/<crate>/tests/<stem>.rs` integration
# target). `#` comments and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Provenance: `docs/V1-WIRE-FORMAT-INVENTORY.md` (its Summary table numbers 32
# wire-format surfaces and names the byte-pin test for each) plus
# `docs/INVARIANT-COVERAGE.md` rows 15-23, plus the S-3/S-6 const-VALUE and
# domain-tag pins minted at the 2026-07-26 CI-integrity pass.
#
# ADDING A PIN: add the test-target stem in the right section. A wrong or
# deleted name makes cargo fail fast with `no test target named ...` before it
# compiles anything — deliberate. A silently-dropped pin is the exact failure
# mode this gate exists to prevent.
#
# NAMING: a target stem must be UNIQUE across the packages the workflow selects
# (`--test <name>` matches package-set-wide). That is why the eleven S-3
# const-value files carry a per-crate suffix rather than a shared stem — with a
# shared stem one corpus line would select eleven binaries and trip the
# workflow's selection-integrity gate.
#
# DO NOT shrink this list below the floor asserted in the workflow.

# --- S-6: absolute byte pins for the domain-separation tag corpus -----------
# Pins all 22 registered tags to literal bytes, which is what converts the
# eleven pre-existing home-crate `HOME == registry::MIRROR` drift-asserts from
# tautological into real pins. Also reaches the three `pub(crate)` KDF labels
# positionally through `registered_domain_tags()`.
f_dt_1_domain_tag_absolute_byte_pins

# --- S-3: frozen const VALUE pins ------------------------------------------
# The required cargo-public-api baselines record const TYPES but never VALUES,
# so `ENVELOPE_FORMAT_VERSION: u8 = 1` -> `= 2` is an EMPTY baseline diff on a
# frozen wire version byte. These pin the values: CID framing bytes, envelope
# magic/version bytes, codepoint-registry integers, did:key multicodecs, ALPN
# strings, KDF/AAD domain tags at their home declarations, Argon2id vault
# params, and the whole META #629 decode-bound cluster.
canonical_bytes_v1_const_values_caps
canonical_bytes_v1_const_values_core
canonical_bytes_v1_const_values_crypto_suite
canonical_bytes_v1_const_values_drop
canonical_bytes_v1_const_values_engine
canonical_bytes_v1_const_values_eval
canonical_bytes_v1_const_values_graph
canonical_bytes_v1_const_values_id
canonical_bytes_v1_const_values_membership_set
canonical_bytes_v1_const_values_platform_foundation
canonical_bytes_v1_const_values_sync
